meta.purpose: Model/connector index across scales for the UI. Each entry is a design PRIMITIVE with an honest capability state - NOT a claim that we designed one of each.
meta.honesty: We did NOT build a working designer for each primitive. Most are proposed or external-connector; only a few have a real run. 'provenance' marks verified_by_fable vs asserted_by_project (a run reported by the project / other workers that fable-lead did not independently verify) vs external/none.
